official_host_review.scope: Bounded current-week check of official release notes; no exhaustive host census or local runtime compatibility test.
official_host_review.observation: Release notes describe improved accounting for retained output during compaction, closing completed network approvals, and documentation for managed network constraints and command rules requiring fresh human approval.
official_host_review.relevance: Preserve explicit host-policy boundaries and label usage/size observations as metadata. Release notes do not validate Skill Loom task quality or token savings. No host update, policy change or dependency migration required for observation-time filters.
official_host_review.decision: Observe only; leave host policies and dependencies unchanged.
